text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss on ASSET-A is currently **SUPPORTED** (evidence unit EU-LFC-01-E7, version 2, current as of 2026-11-12). It replaces version 1, which was only "pending corroboration" in 2022 because no later year had been observed yet.

- **Extent:** Hansen/UMD maps about 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property. A further 37.3 ha was lost in patches under 0.5 ha, which are not counted as an event.
- **Corroboration:** Data through 2025 have now been observed, and the JRC 2020 map shows forest over 98% of the event area.
- **Context:** The MGAP 2021 map shows 68.1 ha of planted pine (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha outside mapped forest, and no native forest.

This establishes tree-cover loss only. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, since cutting a plantation also counts as loss. It also does not establish the cause, legality, responsible actor or any compliance finding.
